title: Raj Kumar Ojha v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
disposition: Notice issued; criminal proceedings stayed pending listing
headnote: Section 528 BNSS application to quash IPC ss. 353, 504 and 506 proceedings, alleged to have been lodged instead of deciding Para 6.5 Supply Code objections, listed for consideration with interim stay of the criminal case.
facts: Raj Kumar Ojha sought quashing of Criminal Case No. 80 of 2024 (Crime No. 230 of 2022, ss. 353, 504, 506 IPC, P.S. George Town, Prayagraj) and the 17 January 2024 summoning order. A Division Bench in Writ-C No. 11135 of 2022 had directed the first informant to decide Para 6.5 Supply Code objections within eight weeks; an FIR of 22 June 2022 was lodged instead. Counsel said the FIR was false, the informant's contempt reply omitted the incident, and there was no pre-summoning evidence.

holding_units.holding: Prima facie the s. 528 BNSS application to quash Criminal Case No. 80 of 2024 requires consideration. Notice issued to opposite party no. 2; further proceedings of that case stayed until further orders; listed after eight weeks.

not_decided.point: Merits of the s. 528 BNSS quash and of the Para 6.5 Supply Code objections
not_decided.note: Only notice, listing and an interim stay; no finding on the FIR or on clause 6.5.
